history.content: felt like an idiot at work today
That sounds really sharp and self-cutting. I’m wondering if it was more embarrassment, shame, or just that painful “I messed up” feeling?
embarrassment i guess. said something dumb in the meeting and everyone just went quiet
Yeah, that kind of silence can make the moment feel very exposed. Does it make you want to hide, explain, or just replay it?
replay it. keeps looping. like why did i even open my mouth
That loop sounds harsh, and like the silence turned one moment into something much bigger. We can leave it here, or stay with what that moment seemed to say about you — which feels closer?
leave it here. just needed to get it out. thanks
Of course — I’m glad you said it out loud. We can leave it right there.
